blurb: Guests join Captain Mike Brantley for fishing trips starting just before daylight and ending when the captain feels a successful catch has been made. Trips include fishing for species such as Speckled Trout, Redfish, Black Drum, Flounder, and Bay Snapper. The captain provides top of the line equipment, water, ice, fuel, and fish cleaning services.
